next.name: eCh0raix ransomware
next.headline: eCh0raix ransomware: QNAP says it has been reported to target NAS devices running older software
next.in_short: QNAP says eCh0raix ransomware has been reported to target its NAS devices through flaws in older QTS and Photo Station versions. The company says fixes have shipped since September 2019.

sentences.t: QNAP says the eCh0raix ransomware (MR1904) has been reported to target QNAP NAS devices.
According to QNAP, the ransomware has been reported to exploit certain vulnerabilities in earlier versions of QTS and Photo Station.
The QNAP advisory lists no CVE identifier for these vulnerabilities.
QNAP published advisory QSA-20-02 on the eCh0raix ransomware on 7 June 2020, with a release date of 8 June 2020.
QNAP says it fixed these issues in releases since September 2019.
The advisory names QTS 4.4.1 build 20190918 and later, and QTS 4.3.6 build 20190919 and later, among the releases.
QNAP strongly recommends updating QTS and Photo Station to the latest versions.
